spans.s:
n. (-चं)
1 Foulness, impurity.
2 Legal impurity, contamination, defilement contracted by the death of a relation, the commission of prohibited acts, &c.
E.
अ neg. शौच purification.

n. (-चं)
Impurity.
E.
अशुचि impure, अञ् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Impure or abandoned nature or disposition.
2 Defilement, contamination.
E.
त्व added to अशौच.

n. (-र्प्यं)
Want of heroism, cowardice.
E.
अ neg. शौर्य्यं valour.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Ugliness.
E.
अ neg. सौन्दर्य्य beauty.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
1 Ugly, unlovely.
2 Disagreeable, displeasing.
E.
अ neg. सौम्य pleasing.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Having a bad or croaking voice.
E.
असौम्य disagreeable, and स्वर a note or sound.

n. (-वं)
1 Ugliness, deformity.
2 Demerit, worthlessness.
E.
अ neg. सौष्टव beauty, &c.
